p1_assumption: P(1st) assumes a 30-opponent pool with ESPN public pick behaviour. It is NOT a universal probability of winning any pool.

strategies.label: Maximise chance of winning
strategies.note: Built to maximise the probability of finishing FIRST in a 30-person pool: a blend of seed and model probabilities, filled region by region at a fixed contrarian risk. Takes upsets the field will not, because second place pays nothing.

strategies.label: Maximise expected points
strategies.note: The exact expected-points maximum. Equivalently: send whichever team is likelier to win the whole tournament through every game. Safer game by game, and better if your pool pays for second and third.

pool_optimized_note: Chosen to maximise the chance of finishing first in a 30-opponent pool, using the method validated by leave-one-year-out backtesting across 2005-2025.
